args: Only fund concrete public-goods deliverables that will be openly licensed and freely accessible without registration. Require a clear artifact, intended audience and delivery timeline.

citations.quote: Deliverable: publish an English-language, openly licensed beginner manual for the Open Map toolkit. The manual will cover installation, importing CSV coordinates, and producing a static neighborhood map.
It will include 12 executable examples and be freely accessible without registration. Scope covers documentation only, not new software features. Timeline: four weeks.

result.reason: The candidate proposes a concrete public-goods deliverable (an English-language beginner manual for the Open Map toolkit) that will be openly licensed and freely accessible without registration. It specifies a clear artifact, intended audience (beginners), and a delivery timeline (four weeks), meeting all rubric requirements. There are no baseline sources to compare against for duplication, and the scope is clear, so the deliverable is distinct.
